Benepass reimagines how companies take care of their people

Our mission is to partner with companies to distribute meaningful, personalized benefits at scale. Every employee should feel that their company looks out for their professional and personal well-being.

We’re driven by our values

Build for the future

Challenge industry giants with creativity, speed, and execution. Scale matters. Embrace technology.

Own the outcome

Act with agency. Learn and iterate quickly. Do more with less. Getting it right matters.

Collaborate with integrity

Treat everyone—customers, teammates, and partners—with empathy and respect. Be direct. Challenge yourself and others. Assume good intent.

Respect the opportunity.

Embrace the vast potential ahead by thinking big and putting in the work. Every customer, project, and conversation is a chance to make a difference.

We practice what we preach

Healthcare

We pay $430 per month toward your health insurance and fully cover dental and vision. You also get membership to OneMedical, Teladoc and Talkspace

Flexible, autonomous work

We’re remote first so live where you’re most happy. We come together in-person as a team 3-4 times per year.

Benepass perks

$250 to set up your home office, $100 per month for wellness, however you define it, $150 per month for home internet and cell phone

We’re growing. Grow with us.
